name: Pwned Passwords range API
operator: Superlative Enterprises Pty Ltd, trading as Have I Been Pwned (Pwned Passwords service)
tier_rationale: Pwned Passwords is run by the Have I Been Pwned operator, an established service with published terms, a privacy policy and paid plans (A8 trusted); P132 and P141 trusted.

reliability.justification: Deterministic k-anonymity lookup against the Pwned Passwords corpus: a match means the password appears N times in public breach corpora, never that a credential is valid (P141 cond 4).

range.title: Pwned Passwords k-anonymity range API /range/{sha1_prefix5} (mode=ntlm)

terms.quote: for any lawful purpose, including within commercial products

range.notes: Quote: HIBP terms phrase recorded by the council (P132 cond 1). The Terms of Use (checked 2026-11-26) apply it to 'Pwned Passwords (including the range API and downloadable hash sets)', and the API documentation states no licensing or attribution requirement and no rate limit for the Pwned Passwords API (attribution to HIBP is still shown, P141 cond 5). Research C0310 terms 'CC BY 4.0 (attribution to HIBP).' (verified_live 200). api.pwnedpasswords.com/range/{sha1_prefix5} and ?mode=ntlm with the Add-Padding: true header: only the 5-character prefix leaves the machine and the suffix is compared in memory (P141 cond 2-3). Plain-text answers have no JSON schema, so the sensitive-provider rule never caches them. Used by the core helper pwned_passwords_internal (P141 cond 1: not a registered module, callable only by secret_scanner).

notes: Shared seed for batches p1-G04-1, p3-G04-2 (P132, P141): batches only extend it (pwnedpasswords__<suffix>.json: extra sources and error markers). Separate registrable domain and keyless budget from hibp. Binding profile (PROFILE_REQUIREMENTS): neutral UA, flags.sensitive true, ttl <= 7 days. No rate limit on the Pwned Passwords API (API documentation, checked 2026-11-26; research C0310): no quota block. P132 lists the host but uses only the catalogue.
